correlation.description: metadata.correlation_uid: the id of the call being served.

hex96.description: A SHA-384 digest in lower-case hexadecimal.

ident.description: A name or an id of the registry or of a key, never a value. It may begin with '-' or '_': a key id is an RFC 7638 thumbprint in base64url, and one in thirty-two begins with one of them.

lost.description: unmapped.sluis.lost: the running total of best-effort facts one process failed to deliver for the tenant of this record (ADR 0029). The emitter writes it; a caller cannot.

policy.description: The policy decision that gated the action (security_control profile): its id and the digest of the bundle.

pseudonym.description: user.uid: a keyed pseudonym of a person, never the person (ADR 0029, Pseudonyms).

reason.description: A status_code: the closed reason of a refusal. It names a rule and never a value; some actors word it in capitals.

tenant.description: A tenant id, or '*' for all the tenants of a grant.

text.description: Bounded text. The emitter also refuses an e-mail shape in any string.

uuid7.description: metadata.uid: a UUIDv7 in the form of RFC 9562.

word.description: A closed word: a reason, an operation, a state.
